buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses i. Bidders are required to submit EMD Rs. 4,11,487.00/- in favour of Munitions India Limited O. F. Khamaria. Exemption will be given to the sellers as defined at Para m of GeM GTC 4.0 (Version 1.28) dated 22.12.2025. Or latest version of GeM. Bidder should have registered in major NIC code “78” (Human resour ces provision and management of human resources functions) in Udyam Regis tration Certificate for EMD exemption. EMD/PSD may be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker's Cheque or Bank Guarantee from any of the commer cial banks and it should be drawn in the favor of CGM or payment online in an acceptable form and the same shall be uploaded by seller in the online bid an d hard copy of the same instrument (except online payment) will have to be s ubmitted directly to the buyer within following time limit: (#) Hard copy of the EMD (Bid security) will have to be submitted directly to the buyer within 5 working days of bid opening, failing which the bid may be tr eated as incomplete & may lead to rejection of the bid by buyer without makin g any reference to the seller. (#) Hard copy of the Performance security deposit (PSD) will have to be submit ted directly to the buyer within 30 days of award of contract on GeM Portal. It is advised that EMD may be submitted through online payment in favor of be neficiary details as given below to avoid postal delays & bank formalities ass ociated with generation and submission of instruments other than online paym ent. If the seller submits the EMD through online payment mode, then seller sh all upload the documentary proof of online payment of EMD along with online bid submission. Further it is also advised that PSD may be submitted through online payment mode after award of contract on GeM Portal in favor CGM, beneficiary details a s given below, and also Indemnity Bonds may be accepted as performance sec urity deposit from central/State PSUs. If seller submit the PSD through online p ayment mode, then seller shall upload the documentary proof of online payme nt of PSD at GeM Portal. Account Name : Munitions India Limited O F Khamaria Account No. : 40436892598 IFSC : SBIN0003228 MICR : 482002006 Bank address : STATE BANK OF INDIA, RANJHI ii. In case of any clarification bidder can enquire through e-mail i.e. ofkpvgrp8@o rd.gov.in OR call at 0761-2742137. iii. For “Geographic Presence” Vendor has to submit GST Certificate with head offi ce location in Jabalpur District. Firms who have not submitted the complete set of GST Certificate with head office in Jabalpur District, their offer will be rejecte d. iv. Firm must have executed at least one supply order of minimum Rs. 1,09,73,0 04.76, or two supply order of Rs. 68,58,127.98​ or three supply order of Rs. 54, 86,502.38 for providing similar service i.e. manpower supply to any Central Go vernment/State Government or Public Sector Undertaking in the last 03 years. Relevant documents i.e. copy of Contract Order and Execution Certificate/Job C ompletion Certificate are to be uploaded by the bidder along with bid. (MSEs &

Startups are exempted). v. Average annual turnover of the bidder for the last 03 years ending on 31st Mar ch of preceding year (2026) must be at least Rs. 41,14,876.78 lakhs. Bidders s hall submit Certificate from registered CA indicating the turnover details for las t 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) along with bid in support of financial c apability. (MSEs & Startups are exempted). vi. Bidders have to submit latest copy of registration certificates of MSME certifica te along with bid. vii. Bidders should submit copy of registration certificates of EPF & ESIC along wit h bid. viii. Bidder should submit the sealed & signed copy of scope of work and terms & c onditions. ix. Contractor should have valid labour license. x. Note to Bidders – Participating bidders may please be noted that GeM Portal is having functionality to monitor bids having same IP address used by bidders / sellers. GeM portal is capturing and reflecting the IP address used by buyers and participated bidders / sellers. The received bids having matching / commo n IP address with other participating bidders / sellers or buyer, then their offer will be out rightly rejected and will not be considered for further evaluation. xi. The AGENCY shall not appoint any sub-agency for the work assigned to him. If subletting is noticed, the contract will be short closed forfeiting PSD(Performan ce Security Deposit). xii. Bidders have to submit “Near- relationship certificate that none of his/her relative is working in the Unit where he/she is going to bid for the tender. The near relative for this purpose should be well define in the tender’’. “The Bidder /Tender shall disclose whether any relative of the bidder /tenderer, it proprieto r, partner director or person having a controlling or material interest in the firm is employed with or associated with the procuring entity. Near relative shall m ean a person related by blood, marriage or legal relationship, including spouse , father, mother, son, daughter, brother, sister and such other relatives as may be specified under the applicable rules of the procuring entity. The Bidder/Ten derer shall submit a declaration conforming above. Any non-disclosure or incor rect declaration may be dealt with in accordance with the applicable tender co nditions and rules of procuring entity”. xiii. Service provider have to follow recently implemented four labour codes effecti ve from 21st November 2025. xiv. The person being deploy should have PVR (Police Verification Report) which is valid for 01 years. xv. The person being deploy having Adhar card linked with mobile no. xvi. Service Provider shall provide PPEs such & Uniform (colour of uniform should b e blue for Non filling area and orange for filling area and should have clear indi cation of working area and name of the firm in back side of uniform) to the ma npower detailed and the contract value shall be including the cost of PPEs & U niforms. xvii. Firm should depute 37 nos. (02 Supervisor skilled, 09 Cook skilled, 12 Vendors Semi-skilled, 14 Labour/Safaiwala un-skilled) manpower on daily basis. Further the person being deployed shall be continued and should not be changed with out prior permission of the buyer. xviii. **Since GeM portal does not have facility to feed exactly 01-year experience fo r Skilled/Semi-Skilled and 06 months of experience for Un-skilled, hence, bidde r must ensure minimum 01-year experience for Skilled/Semi-Skilled and minim um 06 months of experience for Un-skilled workers with supporting documents during deployment.

xix. Payment shall be made on monthly basis. xx. Performance Security Deposit (PSD) is to be furnished by the successful bidder within 30 days after placement of contract. If the firm fails to submit the PSD w ithin the specified date, it shall be treated as an unreliable firm and shall be go verned as per existing guidelines on penalties issued by MoD/MIL/GeM. xxi. Other Terms & Conditions will be applicable as per SLA of GeM and uploaded S cope of Work as per ANNEXURE-1 for which these are not defined separately in ATC. xxii. Price Variation Clause is applicable. In case of any changes in the minimu m wages as per the Applicable Laws during the Contract period, Buyer shall pa y the Service Provider the difference in wage from the amount mentioned in th e contract on pro rata basis. xxiii. Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they don’t upload any of the documents/ certificates sought in the tender along with the bid. xxiv. Also bidder has to arrange rain coat, umbrella, winter jacket etc. whenever req uired for his worker. No extra charge shall be claimed by service provider for t hese items. xxv. Bidders has to timely pay salary to its worker i.e. on or before 7th of succeedi ng month. xxvi. Bidder has to provide monthly salary slip and ID card to its worker. xxvii. If the workers are employed on national holiday, double salary on that day has to be paid by the contractor. xxviii. Payment Terms:- Payment shall be made as per the applicable terms & con ditions of the GeM service Agreement (SLA) and uploaded Scope of Work as p er ANNEXURE-1. xxix. Termination & Penalty Clause :- i. In case of short supply, deduction from the next bill for the short supply of minimum manpower or items on pro-rata basis or actual basis, whenever a pplicable, at prevailing cost for which OFK will have to spend for arranging t he short supply along with penalty for unsatisfactory performance/service s hall be imposed. ii. Penalty will be imposed in case the attendance goes below 90% on any wor king days. The formula to impose penalty will be as follows: - iii. Penalty= No. of laborers falling short of 90% attendance x twice the daily w ages of laborers. iv. Shortage of labour attendance upto 90% shall not be allowed for more than 2 occurrences in a week & cumulative 5 occurrences in a month. v. PSD- The successful Tendered will have to pay security deposit of 5% of tot al order value within 30days of placement of contract. vi. In case of unsatisfactory performance/service the contract will be liable to b e terminated at any time giving 7 days’ notice and forfeiting the security de posit. In addition, a penalty up to 10% will also be lived, at the discretion of buyer. vii. Buyer reserves the right to suspend/cancel the contract at any time without assigning any reason. Other Penalty terms as per uploaded Scope of Work as per ANNEX URE-1 and GeM SLA. Option Clause – The buyer reserves the right to increase/decrease the qua ntity up to 50% at the time of placement of contract. The buyer also reserv es the right to increase the ordered quantity by up to 50% of the contract q uantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingly. In case of multi L-1 offers, “Run L-1 Selection” tool provided by GeM system ma
y be used and the contract will be awarded to GeM system selected L-1 firm with existing terms & conditions. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
